scope: Read-only bounded audit of the last 18 of 36 authored semantic method proposals, sorted by ideas-search order (IDEA000025, 026, 027-033, 036-041, 064, 066, 072).
recommendation: Do not reopen or promote a proposal from this screen. The current gates are design/binding deficiencies or correctly scoped rival warnings; no verified error was found that demands confirmed meaning before a runnable structural test, and no copying/context rival is falsely forced to be flat.

screen_findings.finding: Owner/panel changes can alter discourse or referents without candidate-dependent semantics; current designs do not name independent referent histories or divergent held predictions.

Each proposal lacks at least one named candidate, independent endpoint, or rival outcome. Contextual association, modality, causality, contrast, coordination, provenance, and genre can all be generated by compatible alternatives; the blockers do not claim empirical failure.

The structural comparator facts are useful, but the proposals either omit a Voynich candidate/binding or leave coupled semantic categories. IDEA000039 still permits component-as-object/class; IDEA000041 mechanism includes side outlet while falsifier targets return/junction. These are genuine scope problems, not over-demand for a translated gold label.
No actual modifier/marker surface, observed alternation/default-override sequence, or component/whole pair is nominated. The current blockers correctly request a named observable contrast.

primary_evidence.quote:
Met 55.121.11 is the closest readable technical-rendering comparator yet.  It
combines a water source, repeated lifting components, a driving animal, shafts
and wheels, and numerous compact marks beside parts.  The reverse is
especially informative: four parallel lifting bays sit under a shared drive,
showing that repeated visual units can be components or stages of one machine
rather than four independent named objects.
primary_evidence.use: Comparator establishes possible structural analogy, not Voynich labels.

primary_evidence.quote:
Direct source-bound inspection found genuine quintessence-tradition machinery:

- Wolfenbüttel fol. 40r shows two connected pear-shaped vessels with crossing
  ducts;
- Othmer fol. 10r shows a return-loop vessel and a second vessel with paired
  internal descending ducts;
- Othmer fol. 36r shows paired domed furnaces, nested chambers, fire, and side
  outlets.

This is materially better evidence than a generic claim that medieval
alchemy used vessels. It supports circulation, paired-container, nested-
apparatus, and side-duct geometry as authentic technical imagery near the
Voynich period.
primary_evidence.use: Comparator establishes topology vocabulary, not a candidate inscription mapping.
